description: TU Delft provides post-construction Sand Motor bathymetry and topography along actual surveyed paths. The source custom field gives a period from 3 August 2011 to 7 September 2016. This source-defined representation is distinct from gridded and cross-shore transect products. Coverage: 2011-08-03T00:00Z/2016-09-07T00:00Z. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: Path coordinates, spacing, variable names, depth datum, sampling and accuracy are unstated. The observations were not interpolated or numerically inspected in this review. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Sand Motor collection identifies a coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring programme. Simulation use concerns its coastal geometry and sediment or hydrodynamic calibration.
